# Zika Virus

**Authors:** Robert W. Wolford, Timothy J. Schaefer

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Zika virus is a single-stranded RNA virus of the family Flavivirus and the genus Flavivirus and belongs to two phylogenetic types: Asian and African.  In the majority of people, infection by the Zika virus is mild and self-limiting. In most cases, Zika infection is a mild self-limited illness. Today, zika virus infection is a reportable illness.
